detail:
New decision "RB7 ruled: delivery on one long-lived branch foundation/v3 (3.0.0-alpha.N in package.json, no v* tags, draft PR opened early, per-stage commits); the in-flight Codex-plugin work is parked on wip/codex-plugin first; session records and the two drafted W2 plans commit to main as the shared base" relates to:
- 01M2K97A9FTJR13S7K7QWH5YHY: "Chose to write the foundation programme plan as a rulings-gated draft (7 ruling briefs) rather than start execution or ask open-ended questions"
- 01M2KAJTVMH24C8A8YKNPTZZ27: "RB1 ruled: the field-urgent twining CLI ships in PARALLEL with the foundation programme — a CLI lane on branch feat/cli-2.17 from main (2.x line, releases as 2.17.0 under Dave's tag) sharing one transport-agnostic command core with the v3 host adapters; foundation/v3 rebases on it when it lands"
- 01M2KAJTYBR5STBGQP98HRTH2E: "RB2 ruled: the drafted W2/2.17.0 and 2.17.1 implementation plans are ABSORBED into the foundation programme (superseded as plans of record; their items map onto R07/R08/R15/R16/R19 work in S1/S3/S4) rather than executed first on the 2.x line"
- 01M2KAJV18PZ3S7S0ECR70KH2X: "RB3/RB4/RB5 ruled: C28 multi-computer qualification runs on Dave's other computer via a scripted bundle I prepare; Codex CLI 0.154.0 is installed locally (Homebrew, 2026-09-15) so lane 03 tests the real Codex host with synthetic projects; the matched trial runs at development scale here under the Claude Max login (flat cost) and the full-scale 360-trial run is deferred to Dave's machine once the solution has earned it — reported as not-yet-run until then"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 4 existing decision(s) overlap
